clusters.name: recommendations-lifecycle-gate
clusters.executionModeRationale: Single plugin, single member, serial. US-003 (release ceremony: version bump + three marketplace indexes + CHANGELOG + AGENTS.md) depends on US-001 (Node lib gate + tests) and US-002 (viewer NOTIFY gate + test) being green. Splitting across parallel members would race the single plugin version bump and the shared CHANGELOG/AGENTS.md metadata files, with no parallelism benefit.
